August 28, 2026


## Meet Aerones at WindEnergy Hamburg from September 22-25


Team Aerones is heading to **WindEnergy Hamburg** with the latest developments in robotic wind turbine inspection, repair and digital asset intelligence.


Visit us at **Hall 1, Booth A1.110** to see how Aerones technology is advancing across the blade maintenance cycle – from detecting damage and performing repairs to turning inspection data into actionable maintenance decisions.


This year, we’ll be showcasing **blade samples featuring Category 4 leading edge erosion repairs** , our latest **Internal Inspection crawler** , and the next generation of our digital ecosystem – the **Aerones Customer Portal and advanced Visual Inspection Studio (VIS)** .


See the technology up close, explore real repair results, and discover how robotics, inspection data and digital tools come together to make wind turbine maintenance smarter, faster and more predictable.


**See you in Hamburg!**


For more information about the event, visit the **WindEnergy Hamburg** website.


Want to meet our team at the show? **Email**[\[email protected\]](https://aerones.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#dcafbdb0b9af9cbdb9aeb3b2b9aff2bfb3b1) **to book a time slot with an Aerones representative.**
